item.title: Brand-New Xbox Game Pass Multiplayer Soulslike is Already a Massive Hit
item.description:
New Xbox Game Pass Soulslike Mistfall Hunter is already seeing major success, as the game has reached a million players. The impressive accomplishment, which was achieved courtesy of Xbox Game Pass subscribers and players across all other platforms, is being celebrated by Mistfall Hunter 's developer, and fans will benefit as a result.

Mistfall Hunter has been compared to Elden Ring and ARC Raiders , as the Soulslike puts an interesting fantasy twist on extraction game mechanics. Players can choose to team up with others or to go at it alone, and it also offers cross-platform play, making it particularly inviting for friends across multiple gaming ecosystems.

Don’t Sleep on What Could Be the Next Massive Game Pass Hit—Here’s When It Launches

Mistfall Hunter arrives on Xbox, PS5, and PC this week. Here is the full breakdown of global unlock times.

By Greysun Morales

Mistfall Hunter Celebrates Early Success

On August 6, developer Bellring Games announced that the game had reached a major milestone of a million players. This is a generally impressive number for many games to achieve, but it's particularly impressive given that Mistfall Hunter only launched a week prior, on July 29. Part of this number was likely achieved due to the game being available on PlayStation, Xbox, and Steam, and especially due to Mistfall Hunter 's inclusion in Xbox Game Pass Ultimate. Additionally, though Mistfall Hunter does have optional in-app purchases, the entry price for those without Game Pass is pretty low, with a base cost of $24.99, and a small discount being offered across all systems as of publication time.

Players must log in to the game before August 12 at 12:00 UTC+0 in order to get the rewards, which can be found in Mistfall Hunter player mailboxes.

Mistfall Hunter is already looking ahead to the future, and has unveiled some of its plans. The team responded to frequent requests from Mistfall Hunter solo players for a Solo Mode for Brandrgarde, and says that in response, the game will be getting a Solo Mode for Normal and Cataclysm difficulties of Brandrgarde by the middle of Season 1, which will be in September. A client update dropping on August 6 will improve Dried Flower Knot drops and will improve stability of the game. Einherjar Mode has also had the Mist Lord Challenge unlocked.

The team has also shared a roadmap which details the additions it intends to bring to the game through Season 2. Season tasks are being added to the game, including Soul Harvest, which will let players earn currency to unlock exclusive collectibles, Soul Coins, and Moonlight Nectar. Phase 2 of Season 1 will "fully unlock" Season Tasks, add Brandrgarde Solo Mode, and add an Underlord Speed Challenge. Phase 3 introduces a new monster, Golden Woodling, and a Random Match Event called Ancestor's Tree. Season 2 will introduce a new Javelin weapon, season theme, season-exclusive progression system, and more. While reviews of the game have been mixed so far, it seems that players will have no shortage of things to keep them busy.

item.title: Fortnite Adding New Sprites During Special Events This Week
item.description:
Several new Gem Sprites are being added to Fortnite during a week of special events focused on finding, upgrading, and collecting the popular creatures. Fortnite has made Sprites a central part of its current Runners season, allowing players to secure collectible friends that provide useful abilities in later matches.

Sprites returned to Fortnite during Chapter 7 Season 3 as battlefield companions that grant passive powers when equipped. Players can bring a Sprite to an Extraction Site to permanently add it to their collection, then spend Sprite Dust to summon it in later matches. Leveling a Sprite strengthens its passive ability and improves the loot it provides. Sprites can also become stronger through eliminations and surviving Storm phases, creating a separate progression system outside the usual Victory Royale loop.

How to Get a Grim Sprite in Fortnite Runners (& What They Do)

The Grim Sprite is currently one of the rarest Sprites in Fortnite. Here is how to get this little Grim Reaper in your game, fast.

By Nathan Round

Fortnite Adds New Sprites During Limited-Time Events

Fortnite Gem Sprites Added on August 6

  • Gem Water
  • Gem Earth
  • Gem Demon
  • Gem Duck
  • Gem Aura
  • Gem Zero Point
  • Gem Grim

On August 2, 2026, Epic Games revealed this week's full Sprite schedule through the official Fortnite Twitter account. Mastery Monday on August 3 increased the appearance rates of the rare Fortnite Legendary and Mythic Sprites while providing double leveling speed and Sprite Dust, followed by Peely Hours on August 4 and August 5 with boosted rates for several Sprite variants. New Sprite Day then brought the Gem lineup into the game on August 6, while Saturday's Gem Hours will give collectors another event focused on the crystalline designs. The schedule also features several different Gem appearances, including versions inspired by existing Water, Earth, Demon, Aura, Zero Point, and Grim Sprites.

A Gem Llama Sprite previously arrived on July 30, bringing the available Gem collection to eight variants once the latest additions arrived. Although earlier reports suggested that Gem Punk would be part of the lineup, the variant does not appear to be included in the final lineup. The new designs are not purely cosmetic, either; Fortnite Gem Sprites also reduce fall damage by 30%, giving them a practical benefit in addition to their shiny visual designs. Although not super useful in a regular match, that bonus could be helpful when escaping from elevated positions, moving through mountainous terrain, or engaging in aggressive high-ground fights.

Fortnite Sprite locations vary considerably and are associated with particular locations or loot sources. Gem Water can appear around harbors and shores, while Gem Earth is found in forested areas and Gem Aura favors mountainous terrain. Gem Duck can appear inside the Mogul Vault, whereas Gem Demon, Gem Grim, and Gem Zero Point are tied to Sprite Chests, with Zero Point also appearing in Relic Chests. Those narrower spawn conditions could make some variants considerably harder to secure than others.

The Gem Hours events on Saturday, August 8, should provide another reason for players to search for any remaining variants after New Sprite Day, and further build their roster. Epic continues to treat Sprites as more than temporary match items, supporting them with a collection system, multiple rarities, alternate appearances, and recurring event periods. These latest additions may not dramatically change every match, but they give dedicated collectors several new targets and another good opportunity to expand their Fortnite Sprite collection.

item.title: WWE Officially Trying to Trademark Vice City Amid GTA 6 Marketing
item.description:
Take-Two Interactive and Rockstar Games just confirmed fans will get an extended look at GTA 6 , and presumably its setting of Vice City, on August 27, and now news is breaking that WWE is attempting to trademark Vice City. As of this writing, it remains to be seen if this becomes any sort of conflict given the nature of the trademarks and ownership, but it could also be that WWE wants to capitalize on GTA 6 itself.

As fans may now know, GTA 6: The Extended Look comes to Netflix on August 27 and will be the biggest look at the game yet. Marketing should pick up around or after then as well, all building up to GTA 6 's release date in November. WWE planning to bring Lola Vice from NXT to WWE in this window was never likely a coincidence, as she could likely capitalize on the hype of GTA 6 for in-ring and for WWE, and it's likely her character (real name Valerie Loureda) would be at the heart of this.

GTA 6 Releases Official New Artwork

Ahead of its extended gameplay look later this month, GTA 6 developer Rockstar Games releases new official artwork of the upcoming game.

By Joshua Duckworth

GTA 6 (Entertainment World Champion) vs. WWE

As WWE fans know, NXT's Women's Division is always popping, with La Primera Stephanie Vaquer making the jump to the main roster in recent months. The same is expected of Lola Vice, although it is unclear if she would join Raw or SmackDown, where she is expected to receive a push from WWE. She is billed as being from Miami, Florida—the real Vice City—and the term Vice City is often used for her, so the trademark is likely in conjunction with that use. As of August 4, as reported by Kotaku and Fightful, WWE has applied for the use of "Vice City" from the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO), but it's currently pending review.

Scratch & Peek

That said, it's worth noting that WWE isn't trying to own the term Vice City but simply use it in the context of wrestling and live sports, which would be hard to imagine either Miami or Rockstar objecting to. There would likely be bleedover in the popularity, of course, but modern audiences understand the contextual usage here. The language of the USPTO filing makes it clear as well that WWE isn't trying to impede GTA 6 's depiction of Vice City:

"Entertainment services, namely, wrestling exhibitions and performances by a professional wrestler and entertainer rendered live and through broadcast media including television and radio, and via the internet or commercial online service; providing wrestling news and information via a global computer network; providing information in the fields of sports and entertainment via an online community portal; providing a website in the field of sports entertainment information; fan club services, namely, organizing sporting events in the field of wrestling for wrestling fan club members; organizing social entertainment events for entertainment purposes for wrestling fan club members; providing online newsletters in the fields of sports entertainment; online journals, namely blogs, in the field of sports entertainment."

At the end of the day, it's just a thing and more of a coincidence than anything. It's quite funny visually, however, when breaking down the relationship between companies. GTA 6 is developed by Rockstar, which is owned by Take-Two Interactive, which also owns 2K Games, which publishes the WWE 2K games. Perhaps GTA 6 protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos come to WWE 2K27 because of this relationship. Strauss Zelnick is in WWE 2K26 after all.

No matter what, fans understand that Miami is Vice City, that GTA 6 is set in a fictional Vice City, and that Lola Vice is from Vice City/Miami, Florida. No filing is going to stop fans from chanting, or not chanting, her name, as it's not likely enough to get her over on its own. She's done plenty of that herself.

item.title: Mistfall Hunter: List of Correct NPCs to Decipher Golden Ciphers
item.description:
Looting chests and enemies is the easiest way to secure Golden Ciphers in Mistfall Hunter , but getting them deciphered by the wrong NPC in Windrest Camp will lock you out of bonus high-value loot. Whether you get a Prayer Cipher, Lost Cipher, Old World Cipher, or Nameless Cipher, each will have a string of words that hints at which specific NPC at the camp can decipher it. This guide will take the guesswork out of the equation by listing all the Golden Cipher words and which NPC you should hand them to in Mistfall Hunter .

Mistfall Hunter Twitch Drops: Rewards & How to Claim (2nd Drop)

Mistfall Hunter Twitch Drops are offering supply chest, epic avatar, and a chance to win a legendary Celestial Mistveil outfit, here's how to get it.

By Ayyoun Ali

List of Correct NPCs to Decipher Golden Ciphers in Mistfall Hunter

Once you get a Golden Cipher in Mistfall Hunter , it'll include two strings of words that will clue you in on which NPC you should give it to decipher. Here's a comprehensive list of Cipher words and which NPC you should give the Golden Cipher to get the bonus reward.

item.title: Major Pokemon TCG Retailer Takes Drastic Action to Combat Scalping
item.description:
Target is taking drastic action in an attempt to combat Pokemon TCG scalpers, by completely removing the plastic wrap on Elite Trainer Boxes. The surprising move may dissuade scalpers from buying the collections at Target, but some Pokemon TCG fans are worried it may be doing more harm than good.

Pokemon TCG scalping has become a problem just about everywhere the cards are sold. Repeated instances of bad behavior around the chance to buy cards have popped up over the years, ranging from store stampedes and brawls over new Pokemon TCG releases to scalpers camping out vending machines to scoop up all available stock. As a result, some retailers are trying to take action to keep scalping under control.

Pokemon TCG Players Can Get Free Pitch Black Cards, But There’s a Catch

Pokemon TCG fans have the opportunity to score some free cards from the new Pitch Black expansion, though there are some strings attached.

By Michael Brandon Ingram

Target Store Removes Seal from Elite Trainer Boxes

Now, a video taken in a Target store is making waves for the way the Pokemon TCG Elite Trainer Boxes are being handled. At an unnamed Target location, two store employees can be seen prepping packages to be shelved. During the process, the two workers pull Pokemon TCG Elite Trainer Boxes and cut and remove the plastic wrap sealing them entirely before placing them back on the trolley, presumably to be put on sale. While no official statement has been made, the action is presumably being taken to dissuade scalpers, as sealed Pokemon TCG ETBs are preferred for their higher value.

The situation revolving around scalping Pokemon cards has gotten so bad worldwide that even a Japanese government group is looking for ways to combat Pokemon TCG scalping. As such, seeing stores taking action isn't all that surprising. Some are encouraging the move, as it makes the products far less appealing to scalpers, so fans and gamers may be able to actually find and purchase them in Target stores as a result. Currently, there's no confirmation if this is being done everywhere, or if this one Target store is an outlier.

However, reactions to the move have generally been mixed, with some pointing out downsides. Some have expressed that removing the plastic means that fans who want to keep their Pokemon TCG products sealed are out of luck if a store does this. Additionally, if Target were to do this at all their stores, it would lead to less available sealed stock of Elite Trainer Boxes, which could potentially drive prices on the resale market even higher. Some have also worried about the possibility that the boxes are being cut and damaged while the plastic wrap is being hastily removed. Further, it also makes it easier for the boxes to be tampered with while they're still on store shelves.

As yet, there's no one solution to combat Pokemon TCG scalping that can satisfy everyone and fully fix the problem. If removing the plastic is to become a new policy at Target stores, it's somewhat understandable, as scalpers and desperate buyers fighting in aisles or rushing to get to the stock can put people in danger and interrupt business. The cards will likely sell regardless, so Target probably won't feel much of a pinch by removing the plastic. It remains to be seen if this move rolls out to more store locations or if it's limited to select stores.
